locked: 2026-10-01, before any final-model training and before any test-set evaluation. train_pr_tft.py and evaluate_run.py refuse to run unless the sha256 of this file and of model_selection_rule.md equal the values pinned in final_config.json; evaluate_run.py additionally requires the hashes recorded at training time.

candidates.persistence: last CGM value carried forward; forecast-accuracy baseline only, no alerting
candidates.twin_only: realistic UKF twin (selected twin mode) habit-scenario forecast; alerts when the forecast meets the spike rule
candidates.pr_tft: realistic PR-TFT + UKF twin (selected twin mode); alerts on calibrated P(onset within 120 min)

reference_only.oracle: simulator-latent inputs (21 static features, oracle UKF); privileged-information diagnostic, never selectable

twin_mode_selection.scope: validation split of split_293.json only; training-pipeline inputs (same meal-log corruption and timing as training)
twin_mode_selection.disclosure: S2/S3 validation numbers were first computed on 2026-09-30, before this clause was written. The clause formalizes the comparison used then (60-min forecast RMSE, NIS as consistency check) and is evaluated on validation patients only; test patients are never used to choose the twin mode.

alerting.probability: isotonic-calibrated P(onset within 120 min), calibration fitted on validation patients
alerting.policy: alert when the patient is at risk (causal flag) and the trigger holds; at most one alert per 120 min
alerting.unreachable_threshold: a threshold above the maximum calibrated probability is unreachable: it is reported as unreachable with no metrics, never replaced by another threshold. If the primary threshold is unreachable, PR-TFT has no alerting operating point and twin_only is selected.
alerting.true_alert: a spike onset occurs within (t, t + 120 min]
alerting.monitored_onset: an onset whose whole 120-min warning window lies within the decision period (decision times start at step 287)
alerting.detected_onset: at least one alert raised within [onset - 120 min, onset - 5 min]

uncertainty.method: paired patient-level bootstrap, stratified by diabetes status within the population

comparison: A beats B on a metric when the whole 95% CI of the paired difference (A - B) lies beyond the metric's tie tolerance on A's favourable side. A is not worse than B when the CI stays within the tie tolerance on B's favourable side. Anything else is a tie.

decision: 1. If the primary alert threshold is unreachable for PR-TFT after calibration, select twin_only.
2. If PR-TFT conformal 80% coverage on the primary population is outside [0.75, 0.85], PR-TFT is downgraded: select twin_only.
3. PR-TFT must be not worse than twin_only on event_sensitivity and on false_alerts_per_patient_day at the primary threshold; otherwise select twin_only.
4. PR-TFT is selected only if it also beats twin_only on at least one of event_sensitivity, false_alerts_per_patient_day, rmse_60, rmse_120; if everything ties, select the simpler model, twin_only.
5. Persistence is not an alerting candidate; the report states whether the selected forecast beats persistence on rmse_60 and rmse_120.
